verdict.rationale: Docs confirm server-side refund endpoints exist (paypal-docs-19) and the agent toolkit exposes create_refund/get_refund tools (paypal-supp-agent-tools-inventory), covering the API side, but the pack has no explicit evidence of a dashboard UI flow for issuing full or partial refunds (only Resolution Center for disputes and subscription management dashboards are mentioned). Missing for 10: explicit dashboard refund UI documentation, confirmation of partial-refund amount support, and independent/hands-on verification of either flow.
